target: Vizuara lab note Exp01 (5 Nov 2026), Qwen3-8B rows and readouts
reference_definition: FP32-accumulated product of BF16 head rows and BF16 h, TF32 disabled; 'exact' means equal to this reference
prompts: 40 MT-Bench first turns (5 per category), 40 HumanEval (first 40 task ids), 40 each Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu: Flores-IN en->xx dev, 5 consecutive source sentences per prompt (differs from the lab note, which used newspaper OCR because Flores was not yet cleared)
generation: chat template, enable_thinking=False, batch 16, BF16, 128 new tokens, one greedy and one T=1 (top_k=0, top_p=1) continuation per prompt; states after EOS dropped
scoring: greedy rule on greedy states; Gumbel T=0.6, Gumbel T=1, top-50 then Gumbel T=1, min-p 0.05 then Gumbel T=1 on T=1 states
headline_certificate: dithered INT4 g128 (Hoeffding, delta=1e-15 per row) with INT8 stage (min of worst-case and residual bounds)
reproduced_if: C2: zero violations of worst-case and residual bounds; C3: zero token mismatches for non-dither certificates
dither+INT8 median bytes within 0.01 of the lab value for every rule
dither+INT8 p99 bytes within 0.05 of the lab value for greedy, both Gumbel temperatures and min-p
each of the five readout ratios/values within 30% of the lab value
not_reproduced_if: any C2/C3 failure, or dither+INT8 median bytes off by more than 0.05 for greedy or Gumbel T=1
otherwise: partial; report which items differ and by how much
notes: Top-50 uses the pre-registered 'read all uncertain rows' plan plus rows overlapping the k-th value interval. Per-state readouts: medians over greedy states of (max bound / max true error) and (mean wc bound / mean dither bound).
